en: Old monochrome postcard showing a large, elegant late‑19th‑century or early‑20th‑century pavilion-style building in a landscaped park. The structure has a central domed section with arched windows and two smaller domed corner pavilions connected by long glass-fronted galleries. In the foreground there are paths, benches and a few people sitting or standing in the garden. The architecture suggests a spa or bath pavilion in Central or Eastern Europe. A small, faint word appears above the central arches on the building's façade.
